fixture.parameter_origin: Directly measured 640KV electrical parameters; nonlinear B/H magnetic circuit calibrated to those zero-current parameters

control.current_policy: FOC dq reference; AM32 native bus-current limit; BLHeli_S nominal exposure reference; common instantaneous physical phase trip

fixture.loss_scope: Modeled winding, mechanical and diode losses; unspecified MOSFET conduction/switching-energy, core and magnet losses are not inferred. Battery-source-to-shafts efficiency also includes battery IR and the shared 10 W auxiliary load.

fixture.winding_scale_scope: 800KV uses640/800=0.8 effective turns, inductances times0.64, PM linkage times0.8. Phase resistance scales only its45mΩ winding term:45mΩ*0.64+5mΩ fixed wiring=33.8mΩ. Both variants retain the exact same640KV-calibrated physical propeller torque/thrust table.
fixture.pack_catalog_scope: Published MaxAmps pack voltage, mass and continuous-current references are diagnostic envelopes. User-specified5mΩ/cell and synthetic OCV/SOC are not measured vendor discharge data. Aircraft all-up mass remains3kg;6Sinstead8S releases174g payload,4Sinstead6S releases182g.
fixture.startup: Each pack starts at its own full SOC with the native battery enabled; no ideal-bus warm start. SOC is transitioned at 2.0–2.5 s and then held.
fixture.current_policy: FOC 60 A dq reference, AM32 native 60 A DC bus-current target, BLHeli_S 60 A exposure reference without an equivalent active regulator; all have an independent 120 A instantaneous physical phase trip.
fixture.field_weakening: Dedicated field-weakening controller disabled; native MTPA and overmodulation retained. Native negative Id can still physically weaken flux.
fixture.qualification: Native complete, lock and fault healthy before and after continuation; held mean physical thrust within 0.5% of 1125 gf per rotor, held minimum speed at least 98% of command, no 120 A physical phase trip, held regulated bus at its exact target.
fixture.scope: Regulated DC supply continuation to exact 1.5:1 TWR equivalent flight load. Not hover, battery SOC, cold-start voltage or a battery discharge threshold.
fixture.mission_qualification: Complete, healthy and energy-feasible native execution; mean physical thrust within0.5% of the exact mission command and minimum speed at least98% of request. Strict minimum thrust is retained separately. No extra command guard is applied.
fixture.mission_scope: Representative continuous flight workload, not static hover or a forward-flight aerodynamic model. These held-SOC controller powers feed a separate battery-endurance replay; the maneuver reserve is independently measured.
fixture.inverter_scope: Native switched timing baseline: FOC ideal complementary center-aligned PWM/preload; AM32 native TIM1 preload/deadtime; BLHeli_S native PCA gate timing/deadtime. No added board-profile sensor/transition errors.
fixture.boundary_method: Independent conditioned 5-second trajectories, bus ramps from 24 V during 2.0–2.5 seconds, 3.5–5.0 second hold. Highest failed / lowest passing bracket to 0.1 V. Startup-diagnostic failures are not voltage-boundary evidence.
fixture.initial_motor_threshold_scope: FOC API undervoltage threshold is 12 V (one half of the common 24 V initialization); bracket results are checked against this boundary.

voltage_efficiency.description: Measured 640KV electrical parameter fixture with synthetic nonlinear B/H and manufacturer-table-informed mechanical propeller load; native switching baseline.
voltage_efficiency.publication_scope: Same corrected 640KV motor, table propeller and 1.5:1 TWR workload as the cover; the 3:1 TWR reserve is a separate campaign. The regulated-bus result and battery-to-shaft efficiency are distinct measurements.

dynamics.scope: Measured 640KV parameters, nonlinear B/H and the same table-informed propeller. 6S 4 Ah, 5 mΩ/cell; 1.5:1 TWR baseline. Gusts and ramps use 100% SOC; unloading uses 95% SOC for regenerative headroom. All controllers use sensorless feedback.

metrics.label: Load gusts
metrics.detail: 80% added propeller-load pulse, 45% unloading pulse, then 50% added-load pulse; 100% SOC
metrics.unit: RMS RPM error as percent of instantaneous requested RPM

metrics.label: 80% unload; 95% SOC
metrics.detail: 80% propeller-load unloading for 300 ms, with 10 ms fall / 20 ms recovery; 95% SOC permits regeneration
metrics.unit: RMS RPM error as percent of instantaneous requested RPM

metrics.label: RPM ramps + gusts
metrics.detail: ±10% RPM commands with 250 ms ramps, 25% added-load and 20% unloading pulses; 100% SOC
metrics.unit: RMS RPM error as percent of instantaneous requested RPM

startup.summary: 3/3 controlled starts. 3/3 completed; 0 phase trips. One startup recovery.

dynamics.gains_summary: Separate speed-step training selected FOC 80 rad/s, AM32 20 rad/s with half integral gain, and BLHeli_S 40 rad/s. Gains were frozen before these holdouts. AM32 and BLHeli_S use external governors driven by native commutation periods.
dynamics.diagnostic_scope: Three selected-gain host simulations per controller; common 120 A phase guard. Startup recovery is separate from controlled operation. No new desync after the 1.6 s warmup. Counts are simulation diagnostics.
